segments.motivation: To track progress, assign tasks, and ensure project completion for their teams.
To organize their personal to-dos, ideas, and daily responsibilities effectively.
To manage team tasks, plan projects, and improve overall productivity with a visual and adaptable solution.

tasks.purpose: assigning due dates and tracking completion
keeping all relevant details, files, and ideas in one accessible place
sharing project status, assigning tasks, and facilitating communication
setting up rules for moving tasks or running commands to streamline processes
connecting with apps like Slack, Microsoft Teams, or Jira for a unified workflow

benefits.claim: The product helps keep all to-dos, ideas, and responsibilities organized in one accessible place, enhancing productivity.
It provides a visual, shared space for assigning tasks, tracking progress, and communicating, which is especially beneficial for remote teams.
Users can tailor cards with custom fields and automate processes to fit unique project needs and diverse working styles.

frictions.claim: The breadth of features, integrations, and customization options might feel overwhelming for new users or smaller teams.
Users may require time to understand how to best set up projects and workflows to maximize efficiency and prevent clutter.
Compared to more comprehensive platforms, some users might find specific advanced project management features or complex reporting capabilities to be less developed.
